subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Channels page resolver fix, or request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but an open cross-repository PR already has closing syntax and contains the focused resolver/test approach, so a new automated fix would duplicate an existing implementation path.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can port it to the current UI path and replace stale proof/check state.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave the fork PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused source and browser proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can port it to the current UI path and replace stale proof/check state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI route-owned page refactor history makes this the closest current owner for deciding whether to refresh the existing Channels view patch or request a replacement.
